title: Only two at a time
summary: A counting semaphore lets K threads in; a mutex protects the bookkeeping.
hints: Counting semaphore: `sem_init(&room, 0, 2)`; each thread does `sem_wait(&room)` ... `sem_post(&room)` around its work.
Inside the room: lock a mutex, `inside++`, update `max_inside` if bigger, unlock; then `sleep(1)`; then lock, `inside--`, unlock, and leave the room.
